notes.title: V0.3.5 Update Notice.
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where a defeated Monster interrupted the Hero’s attack animation—battles are now smoother.

Corrected the gold icon display error during Moon Notification (Quick Hide) mode.

Fixed a bug where an empty dialogue box appeared at the Altar after switching to the Sun Button in Quick Hide mode.

Resolved a bug allowing Monster summoning during the Boss phase—now summoning is disabled during Boss fights.
New Optimizations
Sun/Moon Button (Quick Hide): Now auto-adjusts size based on game resolution.

The upgrade button of Decor becomes unclickable at max level, keeping the interface clean.

Sacrificing a Rare Hero (i.e., a shiny card in the Hero Collection) boosts the chance of hatching a Rare Hero from the egg.

Eggs with multiple genes (the four icons below age in the Hero info panel) now have a lower chance of hatching single-gene Heroes.

The Altar now has a rare chance to summon UR Heroes.

Healing clicks for Heroes increased to a max of 10 per second (up from 2), with adjusted healing amounts and improved Healing Tree efficiency.
